searchText: MSRP $739,149. The New 2026 Entegra Coach Aspire 44D. Features Starlink Satellite Theater Seats Booth Dinette Double Lav Sink in Main Bathroom More About This RV This luxury bath & 1/2 diesel motor coach measures approximately 44 feet 11 inches in length and is backed by Entegra Coach's superior 2-Year/24K Mile Limited Coach & 5-Year Limited Structural Warranties. New for 2026 on the Aspire is the larger square-shaped windows with wood framed valances and a leather accent, LED strip lighting in bed base and under the sofa/dinette cabinets, upgraded tile work in the entry well, GE convection microwave with air fryer and larger Samsung Smart TV in the bedroom.
